check.prompt: How many edges does a cube have?

figure.alt: A solid shape with 6 flat square faces, all the same size.

hints: An edge is where two faces meet.
Count the edges round the top, then round the bottom.
Then count the edges going up the sides.
check.explanation: A cube has 4 edges on top, 4 on the bottom and 4 up the sides. That is 12.

check.prompt: What shape are the faces of a cube?
hints: Imagine printing one face on paper.
Count the sides of the face.
Are all the sides the same length?
check.explanation: Each face of a cube is a square.
